description: The bar chart illustrates MAP@10 values for two sampling strategies—“Fine-to-Coarse Sampling Strategy” and “Uniform Sampling Strategy”—evaluated across different values of the parameter m. The horizontal axis contains the categories m, shown as discrete values 6, 7, 8, 9, and 10 (displayed twice as two separated clusters corresponding to the two strategies), with no explicit axis label beyond “m” and a categorical/discrete layout rather than a continuous scale. The vertical axis is labeled “MAP@10” and uses a linear scale ranging from 23.0 to 27.0, with tick marks shown at 23.0, 23.5, 24.0, 24.5, 25.0, 25.5, 26.0, and 27.0 (0.5 increments). In the left cluster, the Fine-to-Coarse strategy is represented by purple bars at m=6 (~25.9), m=7 (~26.7), m=8 (~26.3), m=9 (~26.5), and m=10 (~26.4). In the right cluster, the Uniform strategy is represented by yellow bars at m=6 (~24.4), m=7 (~24.8), m=8 (~25.6), m=9 (~25.2), and m=10 (~24.4). The bars are not stacked; they are separated into two groups by strategy, with a legend in the upper-right identifying the colors, and there are no visible annotations or special emphasis beyond the color coding and the grouped layout.
